rangs snga dgong thun bzhir bcad pa'i sgo nas/ nyer bzhi'i dgong thun yan la zhag bdun phrag gnyis pa'o/ yang nyer bzhi'i srod thun nas dbu rtsams/ hūX hūX sogs lus lhar gyur sngar ltar gsal btab mtshams thun mgor hrī zhes brjod pas hūX yig thams cad mkha' 'gro mar gyur pa thams cad kyang hūX sgra di ri sgrog pa sogs dmigs pa gzhung nang ltar tshes gcig gi dgong thun yan la zhag bdun phrag gsum pa'o/ /yang tshes gcig gi srod thun nas mgo rtsams lhar gsal btab rjes rang gi mgrin par hūX dmar mtshon gang byu ru lta bur gsal btab 'od 'phros mkha' 'gro rnams hūX sgra sgrog pa sngar ltar las khyad par mkha' 'gro ma rnams hūX sgra sgrog bzhin bro brdung khrig khrig sogs gzhung du gsal ba tshes brgyad nas mdzad tshes dgu'i dgong thun yan la zhag bdun phrag phyag bzhi pa thon mtshams/ de nyid snga thog nas mchod gtor sogs bsreg chug tu byas pa rnams brten gyi mdun du bshams/ srod thun nas skyabs sems rgyal chen sogs las byang gzhung bsrangs/ 'dzab bzlas skabs sdig sgrib byang zhing khog pa gang pa'i dmigs pa dang ldan pas bya nang khengs bzhin pa de kha nas spros pas dmigs pa dang bcas pas bya/ hrīXzhes brjod pa hūX rnams mkha' 'gro sde lngar khra shig song ste de rnams kyang hūX sgra sgrog pa bsam zhing bya/ rang nyid drag mthing du gsal ba'i mgrin par hūX
༄tshi/ /dmar mtheb mtshon gang pa byi ru lta bu gcig gsal btab pa 'od 'phros pa'i mthus/ snang srid thams cad 'od zer des khyab pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang lus gar stobs dang bcas khrab bzhin hūX sgra dir dir sgrags pa'i mthus/ 'jig rten stong gsum thams cad ldeg ldeg 'ur 'ur chem chem g.yo zhing mgul bas/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems skye 'gro sems can snang srid sde brgyad thams cad bdag nyid drag rtsal gyi ting nge 'dzin des dbang du 'dus par bsam zhing 〈bzhin 〉du nyer gcig bzlas pa 'di ni dbang chog las kyang / bsnyen pa gsum brgya nyer gcig gis4༷༷ dbang gi byin brlabs nus pa skyedagiX zhes pa'i dgongs pa shin tu zab pa'i don rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal shes phyag len gzhung don dang ma 'gal zhing bcos med pa'i don yin la/ dbang du bsdu ba'i dmigs bzlas de'i mtshams/ dngos grub blang ba'i yig chung nang du gsal ba'i dngos grub blang ba'i snying po/ ā+oX āXhūX badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūXca na na kha dhecu sarba sid+dhi: a yu sid+dhi: zhes pa de'i bzlas pa gnang ba'i tshe/ dmigs pa yig chung de nang du gsal ba'i 'jig rten khams kyi longs spyod lnga 'ub kyi bsdus la tshe'i byin gyis brlabs zhes pa'i bar de gsungs ngag tu yang 'don par mdzad nas sngags bzlas la rtso bor ston/ dpal gtor la dngos grub blang / tshogs la rol/ lhag ma
brtson du bzung zhing lhag chog gi mthar tshang srod thun dang / de bzhin yang tshogs gsar pa bshams mchod gtor kha gsos thor thun la yang gong bzhin/ yang tshes bcu'i dgong thun kyang de bzhin/ dgong thun gyi tshogs rol lhag ma dang de yan thun gsum gyi lhag gtor bshams la ltos pa'i byang shar mtshams su bsags pa rnams dang bsres pa kha chus bran/ phyir btang / chad tho bsngos/ bstan ma skyang / de dag gi skabs su thun bzhir bcad de phrin las rnam pa bzhi dang sbyar ba'i dgongs pa yang / dang po ni gter gzhung gsang ba rin chen 'dus pa las/ hūX hūX zhes pa drag po brjod pa yis/ /snang srid 'jig rten rmang nas ldeg cing 'khrug / 'ur 'ur chem chem kun tu g.yo zhing 'gul4༷༷ de ltar bzlas pas dngos sam rmi lam dugiX ces sogs bshad pa'i don yang srod kyi thun gnas dbu rtsams pa'i dgongs pa yin zhing / yang gzhung de nyid las / hūX sgra rdo rje drag po'i snang glu yigiX hūX sgra brtsegs ma ngar ldan thog ltar bzlas4༷༷ zhes thun drag po'i sgrags tshul dmigs bsal dpe' 〈dpes〉bstan nas/ snga thun gyi zhi ba sogs lhag ma gsum gyi sdoms su yang gzhung de las/ dal bar bzlas pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyabaltoX zhes bshad la de yang thun bzhir phye ba la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ gzhung las/ srod kyi dus su rdo rje srin po yigiX ngur sgra drag po'i hūX gis lha srin
༄tshi/ /'dul4༷༷ zhes pa ji ltar na/ gong du gsal smos bzhin gnyis rtsegs ngar ldan du bcad la drag por bzlas pa dang / de rjes gzhung las/ tho rangs dus su hūX gi snang glu yis4༷༷ ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdugiX zhes pas rgyas pa'i don dang sbyar dus der dngos grub blang ba'i dpe bdun rtsegs su bcad pa/ g.yu 'brug tshang nas ngur tshul du bzlas/ de rjes gzhung las snga dro dus su zhi ba shub po ya4༷༷dngos po bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam smin sbyangs4༷༷ zhes pas zhi ba hūX gcig bzhin rang gi gos kyi gong pas go ba tsam du chu po mnyam sbyang gangs ri la chu thigs pa thig thig babs pa'i tshul du bzlas/ de rjes gzhung las dgong kyi dus su hūX gi gdung dbyangs kyis4༷༷ rig 'dzin bla ma'i rnal 'byor chen po sgomagiX zhes pa dbang gi dgongs pa hūX lnga rtsegs su bcad ste bzlas pa ste/ zhi drag gcig ma gtogs pa'i rgyas pa dang dbang gnyis kha la/ pho skad kyi 'gying rtsal/ mo skad kyi gnyen rtsal/ ma ning gi dbyangs kyi dus rgyun du nyams su blang ngo / /zhes pa bsnyen pa lam du gzung thabs gter gzhung 'di skor rang nas 'byung ba'i don te bdun tshan dang lnga tshan bcad pa'i skabs/ pho skad zhes sbom rags che ldir gyi bdun tshan je chung gi ring nas shed je che chung ba'i snyan cha dang bcas mo skad lta bu'i bdun tshan du bcad pa'i mnyen rtsal/ de dag gi
bar skabs 'brel byed du gre ba shas mi 'gro ba'i sbom phra zung sbyor du byed pa la ma ning zhes pa'i gda' bcad du de gsum snol ba lta bu/ ji ltar lnga tshan du bcad pa la yang rigs 'dre la/ nyin gung sogs thun mtshams su rtsol bral ngang la bzhag zhes pa gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs pa skyong ba dang / nam phyed sku lus 'byung ba bzhi'i cha snyoms phyir glo g.yas 'og tu seṅge'i nyal stabs su gzim pa'i tshe/ thugs 'dun rtse gcig tu dril ba thugs nang du yi ge hūX gcig la gtad nas ci bder mnal sad ma thag hūX hūX zhes skad cig dran rdzogs su lhar ldang / lus gnad bsnyen pa'i ring / gzhung gi dmigs gsal ltar drang srong tsog bur sgom thag gi bsdams na bzhugs bde/ khrid yid du bshad yong bas sems dpa' rdo rje'i skyil krung la/ rnam snang chos bdun la g.yo med ma gtogs bskyang / bub 'gyel gnyid spang / de ltar brtson pa lhur bzhes/ rab zla ba gcig ngag bcad/ gal te thun mtshams su gsung ngag gtong ba sogs ji ltar 'tsham pa'i sgo nas zla grangs gcig la gsung bsnyen grags rtags yongs su rdzogs par 'gro ba yang nyin zhag phrug re rer nyi khri chig stong don gyis 'gro ba ma gtogs phyag 'phreng la grangs bcug mdzad mi dgos pa sogs 'di ltar bka' srungs snyan cha che bas/ phyag len mthong brgyud ngag rgyun gyi dkrol ba ma gtong / da snga
༄༅/ /brtsi chos 'di 'dra mi snang lags kyang / o rgyan chen po nyid la bcos min gyi thugs dad che ba'i skyes bu chen po'i mdzad pa la rjes su yid rang bas zab mo'i gter chos 'di skor la mkhas shing grub pa mnyes pa'i/ rig 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po sogs bla ma dam pa tshad thub drug gi zhabs pad nye bar brten pa'i bka' drin las ji ltar thob pa/ 'khrul pa med pa'i dmar khrid du mchog gi sprul pa'i sku zhabs drung rin po che bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi bka' stsal spyi bor blangs te/ g.yas su byang phyogs su skyes pa'i sngags pa rgan po ral pa'i khur can/ dpal bkra lhas stobs rgyal dbang po'i sde zhes grags la/ ming g.yin zab mo gter kha las/ mkha' 'gro phrin las yongs grub rtsal gyis skyo mda' chos sde chen po'i gam/ gu ru pad+ma'i e waX lcog sgar du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ sprul sku mdo sngags bstan pa sgron me nyid kyis gyis/ 'di bka' srungs gter bdag dam can rnams kyis bka' gnang ba rab tu sbyin te rnam pa kun tu dge legs 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod cig/ //maṅga laX// //
༄tshi/ /thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi sbyin sreg ye shes rab 'bar gsal byed kyi cho ga dngos grub myur ster zhes bya ba las zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi zin bris zur du bkol ba bzhugs so/ /
'tsho: ༄tshi/ /gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang dgongs pa dang / dbyer med rgyal ba'i spyi gtsugs pad+ma 'byung / gang gi 'dzad med phrin las chu gter gyis/ yongs gang dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ de yang byang gter thugs sgrub mthing kha'i phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg ye shesarab 'bar zhesabya ba las/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga phrin las ngag 'don rnam zur du bskol ba la/ sngon 'gro cho ga rgyasapar spro na sa lha sogs snga 'gyur spyi ltar bya zhing / 'dir bsdusapa slong bzung sbyangs pa gsum las/ dang po sa blangs ba ni/ gang du cho ga byasapa'i sar dkar dmar gtor ma bshams pa chab kyisabran te bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas gtor ma raX yaX khaX gyisabasreg gtor bkrus: rtsoXr+sha āXhūX lan gsum gyisabadud rtsir byin gyisarlabs/ sarba bhu mi pa te ā garā ya dza dza: zhesadakar nag 'di sa'i bdag po rnams gakugs ste gtor ma byin zhing bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūX sa 'di rnams la dbang mdzad pa'i: lha klu gnod sbyin nam mkha' lding: dri za lha min mi'am :: 'byung po mthu chen ldan pa rnams: 'dod yon gtor ma 'di
༄tshocaX bzhes lacaX bdag gi cho ga ma thon paracaX khyod kyi gnas 'di bdag g.yar gyi'oX 'di ru bar gcod ma byed paracaX ci bder bar ni gzhan du gzuracaX zhesagator ma phyir btang ngo / /gnyisapa sagazung ba ni/rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal rdor dril 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbusasu 'dug la mig gnyisakyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbusasu hūX re re bsam pa las me 'bar bar bsam la phyogs kun tu sdang mig tu blta zhing / hūX sems can kun la phan phyir du'oX zlasab dastu1na nga yi dkyil 'khor bri'oX lha klu gnod sbyin sha za dngacaX srin po yi dwags 'byung po dngacaX mkha' 'gro gnon po nam mkha' ldingacaX rig sngags grub pa mi 'am ci'oX phyogs dang 'khor du bcas pa rnamasacaX rdo rje 'chang gi bka' byung gisacaX 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengasacaX gang dag mi 'a91 'dug gyur na'oX phyag na rdo rje hūX zhes pasacaX klad pa tshal pa brgya ru 'gemasacaX hūX hūX hūXcaX zhesa'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan du bsam
la rdo rje'i 'grosakyisabaskor ba'am bsam pas kyang 'grub nyung / bdag las sprul pa'i khro bo'i 'jig rten khengs pa sprosate bgegs rnams dpag tshad brgya mthar bskrad cing tshur 'dusapas khro bo'i gur khang du bsam mo/ /gsum pa sbyangs ba ni/ dri bzang gi chu 'thor zhing / 6༷/ ha na ha na 11 dha hūX phaṭa: zhesachag chag 'dab pa/ 'byung ba gsum gyi sbyangs ba ni/ rang snang gsal ba'i mig g.yas raX lasanyi ma/ g.yon pa khaX lasazla ba/ sna bug yaX lasarlung rnams bsam pa te dngosapor 'dzin pa thams cad raX lasame 'bar te bsreg pa khaX lasachu byung ste bkrus/ yaX lasarlung byung bas gtor bar bsam la/ raX yaX khaX ci rigs brjod do cho ga dngosal sbyor dngosarjesagasum las/ dang po sbyor ba'i cho gas dkyil 'bor khri ba dang / sreg rdzasamachod rdzas bshamasapa sogs kyi dang po dkyil 'khor bri ba ni bri thab dang rtsig thab gnyisabashad pa'i brtsig thab ni/ spyi ltar shesdgosashing / 'dir brisathab bshad pa ni/ rang kha shar bstan gyi mdun du sa steng 'dom gang gru bzhi pa ji ltar rigs pa'i dpangasadang ldan pa la dri bzang dang bdud rtsi chag chag btab pa'i steng zag chen brgyad btab pa'i dbusasu sor brgyad kyi zlum bskor lter ba 'dab ma brgyad dang bcasapa'i lha gnas dang / de'i phyir kha khyer dang mu ran so sor zlum bskor sor bzhi pa resabaskor zhing / r+sāsteng spang dang ldan pa yin na mi dgosakyang / de ltar ma yin pa'i tshe sa stegs kyi dpangasapor bzhi ba'i cha na gru bzhir btab/ mtshon gyi bri ba ni lte ba dang 'dab brgyad dkar po ༷hū dkar po re bri ba'am/me tog dkar po'i tshom bu bkod kyang 'grub par 'gyur zhing / rdo rje brisakyang rung / kha khyer mu ran gang rigs la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang / phyi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rtse nang bstan re bri ba dang / gzhi mtshon thams cad dkar po la bcad rnams dmar skya lta busabya ba sogs lag len ltar la kha khyer
༄tshi: nas lci ba srog chags med pa 'am yang na bud lhang tsan+dan dkar po dang shug pa sogs zhi ba'i bud shing gi zlum par khru gang brtsigs/ de'i dbusasu pam shar lhor me tshang gi ting lo mar khur+sābakang ba dang thab kyi nang du lasamathun gyi bud shing phra mosazang zing du dgang ngo / sreg rdzasakyi gtso bo yam lhang yang lcang ma srin busam zosapa rul ba chag sogs med pa'i sor brgyad pa rtsa rtse mor mar gyi byugs pa 'das ma 'das kyi dbye ba phye ba'i grangs 'osatshad dang / mar khu zho zan/ til rnamasagacig tu bsresan lag len bde bar phye mar la/ nas dkar btsosapa'i nasachan/ shug pa tsan dan dkar po rnams dmigs kyi bsal ba/ gzhan yang / yungs dkar/ so ba/ dur wa 'am ram pa/ ku sha sman ma/ bra bo dang yungs nag gnyisam yin pa'i 'bru sna/ 'o ma zho/ sbrang bur ka ra/ dug rigs ma 'dresapa'i sman sna/ dar zab sna tshogs/ mdog dkar zhing dri zhim pa'i me tog sna tshogs/ shing tog gi rigs/ sposasna tshogs bsresapa rnams ste yam shing dang mar khu min pa thams cad gcig tu bsresaste/ 'dasam 'das kyi dbye bas tshan pa gnyisasu byas ste/ nya lcibasasam shel lam dngul/ kham pa dkar po'i snod la sogs par rang gi g.yasaphyogs su stegs la ras dkar po sogs bting ba'i steng du bshams/ 'jig rten me lhar so rtsi 'bul bar spro na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bkod/ g.yon logs su 'jig rten me lhar dkar gtor zlum po dang nyer spyod sbrang tshar/ ye shesapar dkar gtor zlum po pad 'dab bzhi ba dang / bla med yin phyir sman rag bkod mdun du nyer spyod lnga sogs bshams dgosapa mchod stegs bang rim can yin na steng du ye shesapa dang / 'og tu 'jig rten pa/ de ltar min na phyi nang du byas pa'i rgyab tu ye shesapa dang / mdun du 'jig rten pa la mchod gtor bshams zhing / logs zhig tu zhi ba'i bud shing yang dgos

༄༅: :ar gtad gtong lugs: thugs sgrub kyi lasagazhung don bstod kyi bar btang: gser skyems byin rlabs: brgyud gsum bla mas bsngo: mkhyen gsol gzu dpang dkon mchog spyi bskul ni: hūX: bde gagosags dbang phyug chen lngardzo'i bstan pa ni: zhesapa nas:mā ra yā rbad: gtor 'brub khung bka' brgyad ltar dang liṅga bskyed pa'i kha bsgyur 'brub khung 'di nyid kyi nang du yi ke ra tsa zhesa'agugs 'dren bden bdar dkyusabazhin la bden pa chen po zhesabasgyur: drag sngags so lnga'i mthar: badz+ra 6༷5 sdi/ ro/ dza: 65 be ro/ ya āXbden bdar 'gugs pa'i ting 'dzin ngang nyer gcig gam bdun gsum gyi mjug: nga ni dusagasum btang nas bzlasapa bya: de nasabaden bdar re dang bzlasapa re spel mar bya khugs rtags byung na 'gugs gzhugs lan gsum mthar: nga ni dusagasum ma dang yang 'gugs gzhugs tshar gcig nas bzlasapa bya/ hūX: nga ni dus gakhru/ma nas: da lta nyid du 'dir khug cigaX zhesapa'i bar gtong : bzlas pa ci rigs mthar khugs rtags byung na: na 31 zhesabaden bdar mthar: nga ni dug ga༄/ma ma gtong: yang 'gug gzhug
༄tshi: :byasal bzlas pa bya: dgug gzhug gong bzhin gsum mam bdun gyi mthar: yungs dkar nag la phur+sā'adebasazhing liṅga la thun brdeg: 'gug rtagasam byung bar bden bdar re dang bzlasapa spel bar gsum bdun gang rung byed/ thun gtor: raX yaX khaX gyisabasreg gtor bkrus: 6༷kho āXhūX gisabyin gyisarlabs: sman raka bran bde gshegs spyi bskul che ba ni: hūX 3mi: bde gatshanags dbang /rgyug chen 21'i bstan pa ni: zhesapa nas sarba 3mi ba~Xgag bar btang: thun gtor gser skyems 'bul mā ra ya brdung: bsngo smon bkra shissogs bya'o: thun bzhi'am thun drug gang ring la 'di bzhin byed: las byang mi gyer ba rnams la sngagasagazhung byed tshe bsngo smon bkra shisasogs gong bzhin bya'o: bdag bskyed sogs byed tshe: bzlas pa sum brgya nyer gcig mthar dkon mchog sgyi bskul nas bde gshegs spyi bskul thun gtor 'bul ba yan 'dra'o: sgrub zhag thon pa'i thun mthar zan ling gcig kyang bshams: ar gtad kyi sngags mjug gdab kha bya ba ni: hūX: che ma31ga pad+ma lngardzod rje|nga rtsa95: ma ra ya phaṭa: cesalingag ma bsgralagong du sh+ka grab: de rjesablangagabasgralan gzhungadang mthun par bar+sāmachan/ liṅga
bsgral zhing slar yang ar gtad sngagasakyisathun brab rjes: bdud rtsi bran: 'jigs byed chen krerdzo drag 21cu nasan ni rwi ti khā hicaX zhesazhal bstab bya hom bsdusapa byed tshe tsher ma can gyi hom khung brtsigs la sman rag gtor gsum nyer spyod rnams zur du bshams: gtor ma ni 'dir dpal gtor chung ngu gcig: rdzas ni yungs dkar nag dug khrag btab mar khu'i sbag pa bshams: gong gi zhal bstab tshar ma thag liṅga btang ma brgyags pa'am: gang bde bya la bsregs dgosal: thog mar sman rag gtor gsum thugs phur gnyisagang rigs kyisabyin rlabasabyed: dpal 'bar yugs sa'i me sbar: thab khung bsang sbyangs: 3steng pa'i ngang las: zhesapa nas: phur lhasteng badzo/nga ma'i lhamags la phyag 'tshal balhagadacaX zhesabar btang : mar khu'i sna drangs mchod rdzas ni: blugs gzar nang du mar khu bkol: gong gi yungs dkar dug khrag gi sbag pa 'debs: dgang gzar gyi btab la 'bul zhing: rang byung galngasad nas: ma hā panyug zhesa'abul/ dgang blugs kha 'gror gyisadakyil 'khor 'bul zhing: bden bdar 'di cho ga'i khrigs chags su mi 'dug theg /bla med ma31gza nas ba lin+ta khā hicaX gong bzhin dgang blugs kyi rak+ta 'bul zhing: hūXcaX khams gakhru/ma 'oshesar bcu nas rak+ta kha raX khā hicaX bden bdar tshar gcig tsam song rjes: nga ni dus ga〈rgyam ma gtong ba'i mjug tu'oX rnam bzhi phrin las: zhesapa nas: mā ra ya khā hicaX zhesaliṅga bsregs mchod bstod yig brgya lan gsum:ma 96gror pa: sogs bzod gsol ci rigs byed: me lha'i ye ro|sa pa gshegasacaX dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'oX phur ba ltar gro brdung bya: dge ba bsngo 9zhing bsngo rtsosmone shos brjode soges bya'o( slo ba dpone gsang nas rang che 'do da dam kha bshad can la dpe 'di ma stone cig e ka dza ṭi'i bya ra gyis lhag:
༄tshi/ /byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs kyi par byang smon tshig bzhugs so/ / swasti/ 'di na rgyal ba nyid lhag bka' drin can/ /o rgyan rje des brtse bas gangs can pa'i/ /skal ba kho nar zab mo'i chos gter gyis/ /mtha' dbus kun tu nam mkha'i mdzod ltar gtams/ /brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs kyi bcud/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'a39) zhal rlangs ma yal ba/ /bskyed rjesags rjesags pa'i man ngag gzhan las kyang / /khyad 'phags lha brag mdzod chen lnga yi gter/ /chos tshul 'di yi dza gad nying bcud la/ /spyod pa'i skal chen du ma nyams rtogs kyis/ /rab myos do ha'i rgyang glu len dang bcas/ /'pho chen 'od sku'i gar gyis gshegs par grags/ /bstan 'gro'i srog rtsa bzung ba'i las tshogs kyang / /sna mang dgos pa kun tshang 'dir mchis pas/ /bod kyi blon po lta bu'i gter yin zhes/ /che thang nyid du pad+ma'i lung gis bsngags/ /de phyir thubaX bstanaX 'dren la zla med pa'i/ /thugs bskyed shing rtas zab chos 'di'i nyi m+baX / /mi zad chos sbyin par gyi mkha' dbyings su/ /drangs par mdzad la snying nas rjes yi rangs/ /rlabs su che ba'i bstan pa'i bya ba la/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha dang ḍāk+kis kyang / /dbyings nas gzigs shing dga' ba'i gar dang bcas/ /bsngags pa'i me tog char du bsnyil bar nges/ /legs byas 'di yis rgyal bstan spyi bye
brag / snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs rgyas/ /de 'dzin skyes chen zhabs zung srid mthar brtan/ /phrin las rab rgyas bzhed don yongs 'grub shog /dge 'dun sde yi rol mtsho rgyas pa'i dbus/ /thugs mthun khrims kyi lhun po rmang nas brling / /bslab gsum la gnas bang rim rnam par brjid/ /bshad sgrub nyi zla'i rna chas rtag mdzes shog /'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par swa la'i ljongs/ /mi zad dus kyi rgud pa kun bral zhing / /snod bcud dge mtshan lang tsho dar drag pa'i/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dpal la spyod par shog /'dir 'bad 'brel bcas skye bar dam pa'i chos/ /chos bzhin spyod dang dge ba'i mthun rkyen yang / /yang dag 'byor sogs rten 'brel phun tshogs la/ /la 'ur 'jug nas byang chen myur 'thob the ga /lam mchog 'di yang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing ltar/ /phrin las yal 'dab nam mkha'i bla brer bres/ /don gnyis 'bras bu'i char gyis nor 'dzin khye1na/ /'gengs pa'i bkra shis dpal 'bar rtag brtan phregag /ces pa'i par byang smon tshig g.yar khral tsam zhig rdo brag rig 'dzin bla ma'i mtshan gyi byin rlabs tsam phog pa'i mañdza'i ming can nas shin tu dga' gus yi rangs kyi ngang nas bris te zla tshes bzang po la phul ba dge legs 'phel// //
